alt: A triangle of numbers with one triangle of the wanted size marked at the apex. Three smaller triangles, one at the apex and two at the bottom corners, are laid over it one at a time. Cells in one of them are marked, cells in two or more are marked differently, and every cell ends up covered, so the maximum of the three maxima is the maximum of the whole triangle.

steps.caption: Find the maximum of the size-5 triangle with its apex at row 0, column 0. It has 15 cells. The last size built before 5 was 3.
Place three size-3 triangles: one at the apex, and two at the bottom corners, each 2 rows down. Their apexes are (0, 0), (2, 0) and (2, 2).
The top triangle has its apex at (0, 0) and covers 6 cells. Its maximum is 30.
The bottom-left triangle has its apex at (2, 0) and covers 6 cells. Its maximum is 25.
The bottom-right triangle has its apex at (2, 2) and covers 6 cells. Its maximum is 30.
Every cell of the size-5 triangle is in at least one of the three. The maximum is max(30, 25, 30) = 30. 3 cells are in two or more triangles and read more than once, which does not change a maximum.
Find the maximum of the size-4 triangle with its apex at row 0, column 0. It has 10 cells. The last size built before 4 was 3.
Place three size-3 triangles: one at the apex, and two at the bottom corners, each 1 row down. Their apexes are (0, 0), (1, 0) and (1, 1).
The top triangle has its apex at (0, 0) and covers 6 cells. Its maximum is 30.
The bottom-left triangle has its apex at (1, 0) and covers 6 cells. Its maximum is 25.
The bottom-right triangle has its apex at (1, 1) and covers 6 cells. Its maximum is 30.
Every cell of the size-4 triangle is in at least one of the three. The maximum is max(30, 25, 30) = 30. 7 cells are in two or more triangles and read more than once, which does not change a maximum.
Find the maximum of the size-2 triangle with its apex at row 0, column 0. It has 3 cells. The last size built before 2 was 1.
Place three size-1 triangles: one at the apex, and two at the bottom corners, each 1 row down. Their apexes are (0, 0), (1, 0) and (1, 1).
The top triangle has its apex at (0, 0) and covers 1 cell. Its maximum is 17.
The bottom-left triangle has its apex at (1, 0) and covers 1 cell. Its maximum is 8.
The bottom-right triangle has its apex at (1, 1) and covers 1 cell. Its maximum is 21.
Every cell of the size-2 triangle is in at least one of the three. The maximum is max(17, 8, 21) = 21. No cell is in two triangles: for size 2, the three cells are the three triangles.
